title_en: Rebuttal to the Theory of Proving Limits for Almighty God (Part 15)
description_en: Rebuttal to the theory of proving limits for Almighty God, Part (15). The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part fifteen continuing the detailed refutation of theories that ascribe physical limits to God.
